style: Style: Minimalist children's book illustration in grayscale. Simple geometric shapes with soft rounded edges and no outlines. Grainy, speckled texture like gouache or a dry brush on paper. Flat shading with gentle light-to-dark gradients. Lots of empty white or pale background, with the characters isolated and centered. Almost no detail: feathers are shown with a few scalloped lines, eyes are single dots or ovals. Calm, quiet, slightly melancholy mood. Roz the robot: a tall rounded-rectangle head with one pale oval eye and a thin horizontal slit for a mouth; a boxy torso that curves into a rounded bottom; long, smooth, tube-shaped arms; two very tall, thin, straight legs.
part-1: A cracked, dented wooden crate rests on a tall shelf of rock above a calm sea. A few sea otters peek curiously over its edge. Scattered robot parts glint on the rocks below.
part-2: Roz climbs a steep sea cliff, arms spread wide and gripping the rock. Below her, broken robot parts lie scattered on the shore. Seagulls circle high above.
part-3: Roz stands alone on a craggy mountain peak, small against a wide, empty sky. Far below, the island stretches out, surrounded by ocean in every direction.
part-4: Roz sits high in a pine tree, looking down. Two young bears glare up at her from the base of the trunk. A few pinecones hang from the branches.
part-5: Roz sits perfectly still in a forest clearing, completely covered in mud, ferns, moss and flowers, so she looks like a mound of plants. Only her pale oval eye peeks out. Bees drift around her.
part-6: At dawn in a wide meadow, a grassy lump crumbles apart to reveal Roz standing up. A crowd of animals stares at her: an owl on a dead branch, a fox, a weasel, a groundhog and a deer.
part-7: Night. Roz sits on a branch of a large, sprawling oak tree, carefully holding a small woven nest with a single goose egg inside. A round moon glows behind her.
part-8: Roz and a beaver stand in front of a large, round dome-shaped lodge made of wood and mud, next to a still pond. A tiny gosling sits on Roz's flat shoulder. A thin line of smoke rises from the top of the lodge.
part-9: Roz stands in the shallow edge of a pond, watching a line of small goslings paddle across the water behind an old goose. One little gosling trails behind the rest.
part-10: On a grassy ridge above the ocean, a young goose rises into the wind with his wings spread, just lifting off the ground. Roz stands nearby watching. A tiny ship sits far out on the horizon.
part-11: Evening beside the pond. Roz, a young goose and a small squirrel lie back in the grass, looking up at a sky full of stars. Fireflies float as small glowing dots around them.
part-12: A large mother bear walks through the forest carrying Roz on her back. A young goose rides on the bear's broad shoulders. A line of animals follows behind them like a parade.
part-13: A V formation of geese flies south across a pale autumn sky. Roz stands at the top of a bare tree, watching them go. A few falling leaves drift in the air.
part-14: Winter. The round lodge sits half-buried in deep snow, with warm light glowing from its doorway. Small animals huddle together inside around a fire: a squirrel, hares, an owl, a fox and an opossum.
part-15: Early spring. Snow is melting around the round lodge, and small flowers are poking up through the ground. Animals leave the lodge in ones and twos while Roz stands in the doorway watching them go.
part-16: Inside the lodge by firelight, a young goose stands and talks with his wings slightly raised, as if telling a long story. Roz sits across the fire, listening closely.
part-17: Night in a wide meadow. A huge bonfire burns in the center while Roz dances, wearing a shaggy dress of mud and wildflowers. Animals circle the fire, and birds swirl above it like a tornado of feathers.
part-18: Three large, bulky, shiny robots stand side by side in a meadow like a wall, facing the forest edge. A sleek triangular airship rests behind them at the foot of a mountain.
part-19: A misty rocky shore scattered with old robot parts. Roz lies camouflaged under a clump of seaweed while a tall, bulky robot looms over her. Geese circle overhead in the fog.
part-20: A sleek triangular airship rises into gray, misty clouds above the island. Below, a huge crowd of animals looks up to watch it go, with a single goose in front.
